title: visuals.toml — project adoption config
description: Declared, versioned project configuration for the visuals production envelope: canvas geometry profiles, theme reference, contract-layer paths, pre-render hooks, and the project's selection of advisory checks. Geometry and contract only — per ADR 0004 no key may express a type scale, a colour, or a layout; design tokens belong to the theme (ADR 0005), never here.

schema_version.description: Config schema version. The loader rejects an unknown version explicitly — it is never guessed. Human authors write it quoted or bare; both are accepted (an integer or a decimal-string form of one integer).

canvas.description: Declared canvas geometry. A profile declares dimensions and insets, not design.

default.description: Name of the profile used when a command does not select one. Must be a key of profiles.

profiles.description: Named canvas profiles, e.g. the corpus's slide (1920x1080, full-slide assets) and title-band (1920x972, the 108px deck-owned title band).

theme.description: Theme reference (ADR 0005 resolution). A bare string is a name or a path (containing '/' or ending '.toml', relative to the project root); an inline table is an inline token table — resolution step 1. Structure is owned by task 0004 and is not validated here beyond its being a table.

web_root.description: The directory served as the web root at render time (task 0017), as a path relative to the project root — it MAY sit above the project root, e.g. a repository root whose /_shared assets masters reference absolutely. Must exist and be a directory; defaults to the project root when absent.

paths.description: The three contract-layer files, relative to the project root (the directory holding visuals.toml). Each must resolve inside the root.

claims_ledger.description: The claims ledger every load-bearing figure resolves into (e.g. governments/spain/research/CLAIMS.md).

consumer_manifest.description: The single join between script and assets (e.g. governments/spain/deck/SLIDES.md).

hooks.description: Pre-render hooks, run in declared order before rendering. Declared only — init and config resolution never execute them. A non-zero hook exit aborts the render with the hook's own output surfaced (task 0005).

advisory_checks.description: The project's selection of advisory checks to run (task 0007). Advisory findings never affect an exit code (ADR 0004); an empty array selects nothing — the report must then say so.

check_thresholds.description: Project-declared numeric thresholds for the optional measurement checks. Omitted values leave the corresponding check not measurable; no bundled threshold is inferred.

styles.description: Optional project-owned named families. Each name has one human description, which may include prose rules. No bundled, inherited, or default style exists.

scaffold.description: Optional project-owned wiring for new visuals, keyed by a declared style. No default or inheritance exists.

style.description: One project-owned style. Its table name is its identity; description may state family-specific prose rules.

canvasProfile.description: One canvas profile: geometry only, no design.

footer_band.description: Reserved footer band height in pixels (the corpus's 62px source-credit band).

delivery_scale.description: Scale factor for the delivery-size preview (e.g. 0.3333333333333333 = 640/1920, the Teams-call legibility check). 0 < scale <= 1.

hook.description: One pre-render hook: an argv executed directly (no shell), optionally with its own working directory.

name.description: Unique hook name, for receipt and error reporting.

run.description: The command as an argv array, executed directly without a shell.

cwd.description: Working directory for the hook, relative to the project root. Defaults to the root.
